mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the cell to work connected the earlier parts: ATP supports both making proteins and moving particles across the boundary.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the ribosome and then placing it in the cell felt a little repetitive, even though the placement picture helped connect RNA to DNA.

surprise.text: The pump moved particles from the less crowded side to the more crowded side, while the same ATP supply also supported protein building.

arbitrary.text: No action felt completely purposeless, though I followed the named ribosome-and-amino-acid pairing before understanding all the details of protein construction.

continue.text: I would continue to see how working cells fit into tissues and organs. The final connection between the cell's parts gave me a reason to be curious.
